purpose: Source-backed jurisdiction assertions for HISTORIX. De facto administration and de jure legal/sovereignty status are stored separately.
rules: Never infer de jure sovereignty from Natural Earth administrative geometry alone.
A place may have multiple simultaneous de facto and de jure assertions.
Assertions must carry provenance and temporal validity when a source provides it.
Unresolved records remain explicitly unresolved rather than receiving a guessed parent.
Contested claims must be represented as separate sourced assertions rather than collapsed into one winner.
